limitations: The initial menu keyDown lacked text=CR; menu.opened false and menu.tabOrder are invalid menu-open evidence, not an app failure. Use b-confirmations.json menu (native Enter+CR, Tab, Escape), five successful widths. smoke-check.mjs now includes the correct Enter character.

Offscreen full-document/region captures may leave compositor blanks despite successful decode, including church/concert regions. Use b-*-church-verified.png and b-*-menu-verified.png for rendered state. b-320-concerts.png has unpainted earlier cards; only its painted third-card summary is cited.
CSS Color 4 conversion confirms solid-surface contrast only; not pixel-level gradient/photo/backdrop analysis.
Desktop Chromium CSS viewport emulation, DPR 1; not physical mobile, browser matrix, zoom, or AT testing.
